results.content:
Title: Women's and Gender Studies Minor | Interdisciplinary Studies Program | CU Denver College of Liberal Arts and Sciences
### Resources. # Women's and Gender Studies Minor. The Women’s and Gender Studies (WGST) Minor is an interdisciplinary minor that focuses on the centrality of gender and sexuality to understand our past and present world. Students must complete a minimum of 18 WGST-related credit hours. All courses for the minor must be approved by a WGST advisor. Students are strongly urged to take at least one course that focuses on international perspectives on women's and gender issues. Students have the option to complete an internship working in the community around issues related to women and gender. Students who major in Sociology and complete the Gender and Society option will automatically earn a Women's and Gender Studies Minor. Complete WGST1050: Introduction to Women and Gender Studies. Complete 12 credit hours of WGST-related courses at the 3000-level or above. Complete one of the following Women's and Gender Studies Capstone courses:. WGST 3020 Gender, Sexuality and Race in American Popular Culture. WGST/HIST 3343 Women & Gender in US History. WGST/ENGL 3450 Contemporary Women Writers. WGST 4010 Special Topics in Women's and Gender Studies. WGST/HIST 4230 Women in the West. WGST/HIST 4303 Sex and Gender in Modern Britain. WGST/HIST 4307 History of Sexuality. WGST/HIST 4345 Gender, Science, and Medicine: 1600 to the Present. WGST/ENGL 4510/RLST 4730 Whores and Saints: Medieval Women. WGST 4511/FREN 4510 French Women Writers. WGST 4540/SPAN 4340 Race, Class, and Gender in Spanish Golden Age Literature. WGST/RLST 4710 Women and Religion. WGST/SOCY 3010 Sociology of Human Sexuality. WGST/SOCY 3080 Sex and Gender. WGST/PSCI 4150 Gender Politics in the Middle East: Beyond Orientalism & Islamism. WGST/PSCI 4215 Women's Rights, Human Rights: Global Perspectives. WGST/PSCI 4248 Gender, Development and Globalization. WGST/ETST 4305 Women of Color Feminisms. WGST/PSCI 4555 International Women's Resistance. WGST/PSCI 4564 Gender and Politics. WGST/PSCI 4827 Women and the Law. #### How can a minor in Women's and Gender Studies complement my major? An interdisciplinary Women's and Gender Studies (WGST) minor pairs well with many majors, particularly those that benefit from understanding gender dynamics, power structures, and inclusivity. results.content: Home / Samples / Education / All Education Essays Examples / Education Essay Example: Gender Differences in Personality, Communication Style, and Brain Based on Scientific Researches. # Education Essay Example: Gender Differences in Personality, Communication Style, and Brain Based on Scientific Researches. **Gender Differences in Personality, Communication Style, and Brain: An In-depth Analysis Based on Scientific Research**. This essay delves into the scientific research surrounding gender differences in personality, communication style, and the structure of the brain. Gender differences in verbal communication have been a subject of extensive research. Advancements in neuroscience have allowed researchers to explore the structural and functional differences in the brains of men and women. Individual variations within each gender far outweigh the average differences observed between men and women. In conclusion, the study of gender differences in personality, communication style, and brain structure is a multifaceted endeavor that requires an interdisciplinary approach. Scientific research has provided valuable insights, highlighting both average differences and individual variations within each gender.

results.title: Gender, Women’s and Sexuality Studies | Oklahoma State University Catalog
results.content: # Gender, Women’s and Sexuality Studies. Gender, Women’s, and Sexuality Studies (GWST) is an interdisciplinary program offering diverse undergraduate and graduate coursework, a minor for undergraduates, support for faculty research and curricular development, and opportunities to collaborate with community and campus partners who are intrigued by how gender shapes the world. In addition to two required courses in Gender, Women's and Sexuality Studies (GWST 2113 Transnational Women's Studies (S) or GWST 2123 Introduction to Gender Studies (DH); and either GWST 4113 Feminist Theories or GWST 4503 Theorizing Men and Masculinities, students choose from other GWST courses (6 hours), and from classes that complement gender, women's and women’s studies (3 hours). Students in Gender, Women’s and Sexuality Studies pursue research in the history of women, in theories of gender, in feminism, in the cultural construction of masculinity, and in the cross-cultural intersections of race, class, nationality and sexuality. **GWST 2113 Transnational Women's Studies (S)**.
